name: qa-automation-project
description: Playwright UI automation + Postman API testing project for automationexercise.com and Fake Store API

scripts.test:api: postman collection run postman/FakeStoreAPI.postman_collection.json --reporters cli,junit,html --reporter-junit-export test-results/postman-results.xml --reporter-html-export test-results/postman-api-report.html --reporter-html-omitHeaders --reporter-html-omitRequestBodies --reporter-html-omitResponseBodies --report-events=false
